combined_cost.interpretation: Successful proving excludes the OOM attempt, compilation, unmeasured sharding, builds, idle gaps and verification.

count_meanings.uniqueAnon: unique anonymous constants covered by verification

failed_first_attempt.interpretation: Host cgroup OOM before any completed claim proof; this is not a VRAM OOM. The retry reduced max-ram from 180 to 100 GiB while preserving 32 default CPU executions.

limits: Single successful retry and final compression; no repeated-run distribution or matched Blackwell measurement.
Main proof and terminal compression are separate timed invocations using different trace settings; combined time is their sum.
The first attempt failed at the 220 GiB cgroup limit; its cost is preserved separately and excluded from successful proving time.
GPU observations are one-second samples, not allocation high-water marks or CUDA kernel time.
GNU time peak RSS and cgroup memory.peak describe different memory accounting domains.
Lane timestamps and root-wrap times are rounded; parallel CPU execution times include memory waiting and cannot be summed as wall time.
No texray spans were emitted on the lanes path; worker intervals include host work and serialization.
CPU-built terminal traces retain the CUDA backend; terminal compression may place large LDE matrices on the CPU.
Native verification establishes the batch header/body count agreement; the independent inspector only decodes the preamble count.
Sharding has logged component times but no external total wall timer; compile/prove/verify sums are not full elapsed session time.

host_memory_sampling.interpretation: rss and cgroup_current are samples; rss_high_water and cgroup_peak are kernel high-water counters read at those sample times. The final gap after the last sample is not covered by these counters.

lanes.interpretation: Integer lane timestamps are rounded. Worker intervals include host work, transfers, proving and publication; execution elapsed time can include memory waits. Parallel execution durations and lane intervals are not additive wall time.

terminal_k1.logged_phase_interpretation: Phase measurements may overlap and are not additive.
